x: On the first small lap of the senior race Vern Blowfield was up to the front with Aaron, the eventual winner, but could not hold his position and gradually fell back.

The Senior race saw the huge field of 493 runners and the leading positions never changed after the first lap and it was quite refreshing to see a bunch of four Southern runners behind Aaron, the winner, and it was a pity that Vern Blowfield was not among them as many think he could have been if he had run.
Congratulations to Matthew, Steven, Alexander, Aaron, Dan W., Robert, all gaining representative honours. 13th OCTOBER 1984 WIMBLEDON COMMON SURREY LEAGUE (1) 2¼ MILES
